propositions: derive_health compares signed pins only against the latest fingerprint generation, falsely classifying unchanged prerequisites as stale-pin-drift when the fingerprint algorithm evolves

an unchanged related ticket pinned under the post-330c/pre-2be7 fingerprint generation is rejected as drifted after commit 1afdbbd0be changed whitespace normalization, despite exact match when recomputed under the historical generation

the attestation wrapper attest.derive_plan_material_pin_health supplies no compatibility check, while _legacy_material_ok already recognizes supported historical full-hash generations for own-ticket attestations

derive_health must accept a narrowly scoped compatibility predicate that recomputes current material under supported historical fingerprint generations and marks a pin current only if it matches the latest or any supported historical generation exactly
